description: This PHP source file implements a database driver class (ADODB_ibase) and associated recordset class (ADORecordSet_ibase) for interfacing with Interbase/Firebird databases using the ibase extension. The code provides methods for connecting, executing queries, handling transactions, managing blobs, and retrieving database metadata specific to the Interbase database system.
external_files: ibase extension functions (e.g., ibase_connect, ibase_query, ibase_blob_create, etc.)

classes.name: ADODB_ibase
classes.description: Database driver class for Interbase, providing connection, transaction, query execution, and blob management functionalities.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ibase
classes.description: Recordset handling class for Interbase, managing result set fetching, metadata, and decoding blobs.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Interbase database using provided hostname, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and logs it if logging is enabled.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about table columns, including data types and defaults.

methods.name: BlobEncode
methods.description: Encodes a binary large object (blob) for storage.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Returns the blob data as-is, assuming auto-decode is enabled.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column with binary data, splitting into chunks if necessary.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL date string expressions for Interbase.
